navigation_and_workspace_context: Provide clear navigation for workspaces, projects, tasks, search/filtering, and the workspace dashboard.
Display the current workspace context consistently.
When changing workspaces, reload authorized data and clear or revalidate selections, cached results, and pending UI state.
A workspace ID supplied by the frontend is never proof of membership or authorization.
required_screens_and_interactions: Registration, login, email verification, MFA enrollment/authentication, account recovery, and session-expiry handling.
Workspace creation and workspace membership views subject to Group 2 permissions.
Project creation, viewing, and authorized editing.
Task creation and viewing, assignment, status and priority changes, due-date editing, and permitted task movement.
Task comments and activity history subject to approved authorization and audit requirements.
Search, filters, archive-aware views, and a useful workspace dashboard.
role_aware_interactions: Owners, managers, and members are presented with actions appropriate to their current permissions.
Hidden or disabled controls improve usability but never replace backend authorization.
A denied mutation must not be presented as successful.
Membership or role changes take effect according to Group 7; stale frontend state must not preserve access.
state_transitions_and_mutation_integrity: Task status controls follow the approved transition graph and allowed status values from Group 5.
Assignment, project movement, archive/restore, and deletion interactions follow approved relationship and authorization rules.
The UI reflects a mutation as successful only after the server confirms it.
Failed or interrupted requests must not leave the interface claiming an unconfirmed state change.
Retry behavior respects the API idempotency contract; the frontend must not invent duplicate-effect guarantees.
loading_empty_and_error_states: Distinguish loading, successful results, empty results, validation errors, authorization failures, expired sessions, and service failures.
Preserve safe user input when appropriate after recoverable errors.
Provide clear recovery actions without revealing foreign-workspace resource details.
Do not display stale protected data as though it were freshly authorized.
search_filters_archive_and_dashboard: Search, lists, pagination, and dashboard results respect workspace isolation, current permissions, and archive visibility.
Archived resources are excluded from ordinary active views.
Explicit archived views require authorization; archived resources remain read-only until restored.
Task archive state remains independent of its parent project's archive state.
Empty results and failed requests remain distinguishable.
verification_obligations: Test required screens and state transitions end to end.
Test role-specific controls and attempts to bypass them.
Test expired/revoked sessions, workspace switching, stale permissions, and cross-workspace data isolation.
Test validation, status transitions, archive behavior, search/filter consistency, failed mutations, retries, and duplicate effects.
Map each required interaction and negative case to canonical acceptance criteria and independently verifiable evidence.

reviewer_confirmation.confirmation_scope: complete Group 9 decision record presented in chat

limitations: This record documents explicit chat approval of requirements intent only.
It is not a cryptographic signature or trusted evidence envelope.
It does not authorize generation or satisfy the trusted resolution envelope gate.
Frontend implementation, typed architectural projection, compiler integration, and runtime behavior remain unverified.
